## Description

Linearizes non-linear cointegrated spread dynamics using Koopman operator dictionary expansions, applying Model Predictive Control (MPC) to optimize multi-period mean-reversion trading paths.

## Where it may fit

Non-linear cointegrated asset pairs, regime-shifting statistical arbitrage baskets.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Funds, Quantitative Market-Neutral Equity Desks.

## Required data

Historical price series of paired assets, dictionary observable basis functions.

## Caveats

Observable dictionary expansion size requires L1 regularization to prevent overfitting in spread forecasting.
